correction: Original prospective contract repeated an outdated ShabaevLocalBackend class docstring and incorrectly declared d-channel matrix elements absent. Actual frozen producer _reference_state_for_kappa includes +2 and -3 d references. The run already used this actual native function; all original numeric gates/results are retained, and only consumer coverage interpretation is corrected here.

component_coverage.Dirac-Coulomb: public ci_solve on fixed common spinors, replay saved energies/amplitudes
component_coverage.static_Breit: public ci_solve include_breit=True, complete static Gaunt+retardation, replay saved RCI
component_coverage.dynamic_Breit: public ci_solve include_breit=True plus complete 24-key orbital energy map; each orbital epsilon is diagonal EOL Lagrange multiplier/(2 objective occupation) from saved same-state gradient, or the existing public zero-occupation one-body convention; symmetric average of two vertex |epsilon_a-epsilon_c| frequencies, real one-photon model replaces static Breit
component_coverage.dynamic_zero_frequency_check: same complete zero map must reproduce static Breit roots
component_coverage.Uehling: public short_range_radial_matrix and scalar_one_body_expectations; point-source local VP on fixed Fermi orbitals, finite-charge convolution absent
component_coverage.WK: public V_wichmann_kroll approximate local model and same full scalar CI expectation, not precision higher-loop VP
component_coverage.SE_default: public self_energy_radial_matrix(method=indelicato): tabulated K/L/available SD rows plus warned leading analytic fallback, orbital-attraction overlap screening; diagonal radial model, screened many-body/nonlocal terms absent
component_coverage.SE_local_discriminator: public shabaev_local full radial matrix on actual same spinors; source _reference_state_for_kappa supports -1,+1,-2,+2,-3 (s,p,d) using hydrogenic Dirac-reference calibration; |kappa|>=3 channels not in that exact supported set (including f +3,-4) are zero, and full nonlocal projector SE remains absent
component_coverage.SE_full_coverage: public shabaev request records actual NotImplementedError; no missing term substituted
component_coverage.NMS: public one-body point-Coulomb Breit recoil radial/CSF matrix divided by A175 mass proxy; finite-size/radiative/higher-order recoil absent
component_coverage.SMS: public two-body point-Coulomb Breit recoil CSF matrix with Z=70, VINTI/SMS2/SMS3 divided by same mass; finite-size/radiative/higher-order recoil absent

full_SE: Full non-local Shabaev operator is not yet implemented. The non-local projector term requires hydrogenic Dirac-Coulomb Green's functions on the B-spline basis and a port of  f/potgen/se_pot.f:nonlocal_se_pot  +  fse_dat.f tables.  Use backend 'shabaev_local' for the local-only approximation, 'mohr' (default) for tabulated F(Zα), or 'flambaum_ginges' for the electric radiative potential.
